How far in advance should I book my wedding limo rental? It’s best to reserve your wedding limo rental at least three to six months in advance, especially during peak wedding seasons in Orange County. Early booking ensures availability of your preferred vehicle — whether it’s a stretch limo rental , Hummer limo rental , or another luxury option.

Can I customize my limo experience for my wedding day? Absolutely! 5 Star Limo OC offers full customization — from décor, lighting, and music to chilled beverages and photo stops. Our goal is to tailor your luxury limo service to your unique theme, schedule, and vision for your special day.

What’s the difference between a stretch limo rental and a Hummer limo rental? A stretch limo rental offers classic elegance and a more intimate setting, perfect for couples or small bridal parties. A Hummer limo rental , on the other hand, provides a bold, spacious experience ideal for larger groups or those who want a modern, attention-grabbing entrance.

Do you offer transportation for guests or bridal parties? Yes. 5 Star Limo OC provides coordinated transportation for wedding guests, families, and bridal parties. Whether it’s hotel pickups, ceremony transfers, or post-reception rides, our luxury limo service ensures everyone enjoys a seamless and stylish experience.

Are your chauffeurs trained for wedding events? Yes. All 5 Star Limo OC chauffeurs are professionally trained and experienced in wedding event logistics. They arrive early, assist with timing, and ensure a smooth, courteous experience from start to finish — allowing you to relax and focus on your big day.

Can I use your limo service for bachelor or bachelorette parties? Definitely! It’s a safe, stylish way to celebrate while leaving the driving to us — so everyone can focus on having fun.

Do your limos cover all areas of Orange County? Yes, 5 Star Limo OC serves all major areas of Orange County, including Laguna Beach, Newport Beach, Irvine, Anaheim, Costa Mesa, and Huntington Beach. Wherever your wedding venue is located, our wedding limo service in Orange County ensures timely and comfortable travel.

What amenities are included in your wedding limo rentals? Our wedding limo rentals include luxury leather seating, mood lighting, premium sound systems, refreshments, privacy partitions, and climate control. We can also provide custom touches like floral décor or “Just Married” signs to match your wedding theme.

How do I book a wedding limo with 5 Star Limo OC? Booking is simple — visit 5StarLimoOC.com or call our customer service team to reserve your wedding limo service in Orange County .
